business_problem: Land O’Lakes needed to help growers make better decisions despite changing weather, volatile input prices, and many disparate on-farm data sources.
solution_summary: Land O’Lakes adopted Azure Data Manager for Agriculture as a central platform for the many data sets generated across modern farming. The cooperative brings together information from crop yields, soil fertility, seed placement, weather, drones, irrigation systems, and soil moisture probes instead of leaving teams to stitch those feeds together manually. Built-in connectors let engineering teams ingest sources much faster, reduce duplicate integration work, and free data scientists to focus on analytics and modeling rather than data preparation. Land O’Lakes then uses that combined data to deliver real-time alerts and agronomic recommendations through its Truterra and WinField United Digital Agronomy tools so growers can make more efficient, profitable, and sustainable decisions in the field.

solution_components.name: Azure Data Manager for Agriculture
solution_components.role: Aggregates agriculture and field data so growers can analyze performance and sustainability signals.

business_outcome: Today farmers have access to real-time data and automated alerts provided directly by Land O’Lakes, and participating farmers have increased their productivity by up to 30 percent since implementing Azure Data Manager for Agriculture.
